# Kairo

> Kairo is an AI-powered verified professional identity and trust infrastructure platform. It turns one-time background checks into a reusable, source-verified professional identity that moves with the candidate — so companies hire faster and candidates carry their trust everywhere.

Kairo replaces fragmented, repetitive background verification with a portable Trust Profile. Every credential is source-verified directly with the original employer or institution — never self-attested. Hiring teams get instant, audit-ready verification; candidates own a reusable identity they can share across opportunities.

Core concepts:
- Portable Trust Profile — a reusable, candidate-owned verified identity.
- Source-verified records — employment, education, and identity confirmed at the source.
- Career Vault — a single trusted store for verified professional records.
- Trust Graph — the network of candidates, employers, and institutions backing each verification.

Positioning: AI-native trust infrastructure for modern hiring. Built for startups, scaling teams, and enterprises that need fast, fraud-resistant candidate verification.
